cases.summary: Runtime warning on Cloudflare Edge with v1.3.8 beta
cases.description: ### Is this suited for github? - [x] Yes, this is suited for github ### To Reproduce - Deploy Better Auth v1.3.7 to Cloudflare Workers → works correctly. - Deploy Better Auth v1.3.8 beta to Cloudflare Workers → runtime warnings appear. ### Current vs. Expected behavior - Current behavior: Runtime warnings appear on Cloudflare Edge due to some runtime dependencies included in the package. - Expected behavior: Since Better Auth is a TypeScript library, the package should not include runtime-only dependencies that break in Edge environments. ### What version of Better Auth are you using? 1.3.8-beta.11 ### System info ```bash System: OS: macOS 15.6.1 CPU: (12) arm64 Apple M4 Pro Browsers: Chrome: 139.0.7258.155 Safari: 18.6 ``` ### Which area(s) are affected? (Select all that apply) Backend ### Additional context The build error points to this file [kysely-adapter/dialect.ts](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/blob/canary/packages/better-auth/src/adapters/kysely-adapter/dialect.ts) Recently I submitted a PR to fix a Next.js build error in the beta version [#4360](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/4360), but I don’t think this is just a build error issue. I hope that Better Auth can be used in TypeScript without runtime issues in any environment. If there are any challenges in resolving this issue, please let me know and I’m happy to help

## Summary by cubic
Prevents Cloudflare build warnings by stopping Vite/Webpack from pre-bundling node:sqlite in the Kysely adapter. Uses dynamic import hints so sqlite is loaded only at runtime. Fixes better-auth/better-auth#4404.

- **Bug Fixes**
  - Added /* @vite-ignore */ and /* webpackIgnore: true */ to the node:sqlite dynamic import inside the existing try/catch.
